purpose: Separate high-resolution codex portraits faithfully referencing current battle boss identities. Gameplay sprites and data unchanged.
correction_to_prior_audit: Earlier provenance_B01_B02 boss_audit incorrectly treated legacy assets/bosses/BO01.png–BO04.png (1254x1254) as sufficient current identity sources. Native dimensions were accurate but those standalone images are obsolete identities. Battle renderer uses EnemyArt.install and current storybook_B01–B04_bodies_v2 regions (230–271px high). That earlier conclusion is withdrawn. These new portraits use current runtime atlas identities, not legacy standalone files.
